issue.title: Is it possible to handle -h and --help differently?
issue.body: Many programs show a short help message with `-h` and a detailed one with `--help`. Currently cobra handles both options in the same way. Is it possible to change this somehow with custom help messages?

comments.author: marckhouzam
comments.body: Interesting question. You may be able to figure out which form of the flag was used on the command line in your custom function.

comments.author: TLINDEN
